title: Child marriage before 15, World
headline: Ending marriage before 15 by 2030 needs the share to fall 0.8 points a year
subtitle: Percentage of women (aged 20-24 years) married or in union before age 15
years: So far it has fallen 0.2 points a year, from 7.8% in 2005 to 4.2% in 2025.
data_line: Data: UNICEF via UN SDG Global Database, series SP_DYN_MRBF15, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Ending marriage before 15 by 2030 needs the share to fall 0.8 points a year. So far it has fallen 0.2 points a year, from 7.8% in 2005 to 4.2% in 2025. Women aged 20 to 24 first married or in union before 15, the world: 7.8% in 2005, 4.2% in 2025. At that pace about 3.3% in 2030; reaching 0% needs 0.8 points a year.
method: Method: linear pace, 2005 to 2025; target year 2030.
question: Where has marriage before 15 moved at anything like 0.8 points a year, and what made it possible?
